Important

Rules & Regulations

Register officially and run under your own bib.

Bib transfer is strictly prohibited.

Follow instructions from race officials and volunteers.

Participants should ensure they are medically fit.

Timing certificates applicable only for timed categories.

Help keep the route clean and avoid littering.

Organisers reserve the right to modify race details if required.
